kicad_symbol_check: pins 1 VDD, 2 SCL, 3 SDA, 4 LDAC, 5 RDY/BSY, 6-9 VOUTA-D, 10 VSS: 4-7 confirmed on ds p2, the rest by the package figure order

circuit.role: bulk (tantalum in the ds; ceramic is fine)
output series resistor to the header, each channel [this design]
circuit.page: p5: stable into 1 nF with 5 k load

circuit.role: ESD array on the four outputs
RDY/BSY pull-up, only if the pin is used

logic: SDA/SCL/LDAC thresholds 0.7/0.3 VDD (p6); 3.3 V bus direct

i2c_addr.select: 1100 A2 A1 A0; the plain MCP4728 ships as 000 = 0x60; bits live in EEPROM and can be rewritten with a general-call command that uses the LDAC pin (p24, p30). Do not move it: 0x64 is the STCC4.

expander: DAC_LDAC_N (optional: simultaneous update of the four outputs)
strap: LDAC->GND (outputs update at the end of each write)

placement: Near the bench header; supply from the quiet 3.3 V branch because with VREF = VDD the supply IS the reference.
notes: Reference for a 0-3.3 V source: select VREF = VDD per channel (full scale = VDD, 0.8 mV/LSB, accuracy and noise are those of the 3.3 V rail). The internal 2.048 V reference gives 0-2.048 V (gain 1) or 0-4.096 V clipped at VDD (gain 2): use it when accuracy matters more than range (p1, p5).

Buffering: each output already has a rail-to-rail amplifier, short-circuit proof (15 mA typ, 24 max) and stable into 1000 pF with 5 k (p5). No extra buffer is needed for a signal source into logic or scope inputs; add an op amp only for loads below about 1 k or cables over 1 nF.

Power-down per channel puts 1 k / 100 k / 500 k to ground on the output (p5). Power-down current is 40 nA only with the external (VDD) reference selected; with the internal reference left on it is 45 uA (p3): firmware should select VREF = VDD before sleeping.
General-call commands (reset, wake-up) also reach the Sensirion parts if they shared a bus: one more reason to keep the DAC on I2C_U.
